summary: Blackstone Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K covering three routine items: an unregistered sale of 2,171,851 Class I shares for ~$52.3M under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg S, a regular May 2026 distribution declaration (Class I $0.20, Class S $0.183, Class D $0.195 per share), and an April 30, 2026 NAV update (per share $24.06, aggregate NAV ~$45.2B, portfolio ~$79.0B, debt ~$37.1B). None of these items constitute a special situation—the share sale is an ordinary continuous offering exempt from registration, the distributions are routine, and the NAV disclosure is standard for a BDC. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or strategic event is present. No action or unusual terms warrant a special-situation classification.
